name: 3D Box: Box 0 descends · 2t at (0, 5, 1) [case 60]
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 2 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 0: 3 cells, starting at (0, 5, 2) through (2, 5, 2); Box 4: 2 cells, starting at (2, 4, 1) through (2, 4, 2); Box 1: 2 cells, starting at (2, 5, 3) through (3, 5, 3); Box 2: 2 cells, starting at (3, 5, 4) through (4, 5, 4); Box 3: 2 cells, starting at (4, 5, 5) through (5, 5, 5). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north.
Tick 2: Box 0 moves 1 down; Box 1 moves 1 down; Box 2 moves 1 down; Box 3 moves 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
